import json
import os

DATA_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data"
OUT_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/cross_dataset"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def identify_source(sample):
    pid = sample.get("problem_id", "")
    if pid.startswith("HumanEval/"):
        return "humaneval"
    elif pid.startswith("MBPP/"):
        return "mbpp"
    return "unknown"

def write_jsonl(samples, path):
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        for s in samples:
            f.write(json.dumps(s) + "\n")

for condition in ["exception_only", "no_trace"]:
    train_path = f"{DATA_DIR}/{condition}_train.jsonl"
    test_path = f"{DATA_DIR}/{condition}_test.jsonl"

    all_data = []
    for path in [train_path, test_path]:
        with open(path) as f:
            all_data.extend(json.loads(line) for line in f)

    he = [s for s in all_data if identify_source(s) == "humaneval"]
    mbpp = [s for s in all_data if identify_source(s) == "mbpp"]
    unk = [s for s in all_data if identify_source(s) == "unknown"]

    # mbpp2he: train on MBPP, test on HumanEval
    write_jsonl(mbpp, f"{OUT_DIR}/cross_mbpp2he_{condition}_train.jsonl")
    write_jsonl(he, f"{OUT_DIR}/cross_mbpp2he_{condition}_test.jsonl")
    # he2mbpp: train on HumanEval, test on MBPP
    write_jsonl(he, f"{OUT_DIR}/cross_he2mbpp_{condition}_train.jsonl")
    write_jsonl(mbpp, f"{OUT_DIR}/cross_he2mbpp_{condition}_test.jsonl")

    print(f"{condition}: total={len(all_data)}, HumanEval={len(he)}, MBPP={len(mbpp)}, unknown={len(unk)}")

print(f"\nDone. Files in: {OUT_DIR}")
